title: Investigate the month-end close bottleneck
privateNotes: PRIVATE_PANEL_SENTINEL: Ask how the panel evaluates discovery. Do not distribute these preparation notes.

sections.title: Customer point of view
sections.body: Fictional assignment: Northstar Parts reports delayed reconciliation. My hypothesis is that exception handoffs contribute to the delay. I would validate the cause with the controller before recommending automation.
sections.evidence: Assignment fact: reconciliation is delayed. Inference: handoffs may contribute. Source: fictional example brief; no real company claims.
sections.notes: PRIVATE_SPEAKER_SENTINEL: Explain why this is a hypothesis, not discovered pain. Allow 3 minutes.

sections.title: Discovery and buyer map
sections.body: Start with the controller: which reconciliation step delays close, who handles exceptions, and how often does work return for correction? Ask who owns the source-system integration and who approves process changes. These are proposed roles, not confirmed contacts.
sections.evidence: Proposed discovery approach, not confirmed customer structure.
sections.notes: Allow 8 minutes; listen for a different root cause.

sections.title: Next step and pivot
sections.body: If handoffs are the constraint, propose a working session to map one exception flow and establish a baseline. If source data quality is the constraint, investigate the upstream process first. Do not promise savings before measuring the work or verifying product fit.
sections.evidence: Conditional plan. Product fit, buyer agreement and impact remain unverified.
sections.notes: Reserve time for questions and a mutually agreed next step.
